The '''LC-9 Thermite Torpedo''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] with a [[Thermite/Legends|thermite]] payload that was a mainstay of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] explosive ordnance line during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The LC-9 was primarily effective at extreme range and against armored [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hulls, and though it was less effective against shielding, the thermite detonation from its payload would often superheat nearby sections of the target's hull and thereby weaken them against further attack.<ref name="Starfighter" />
